desc: the layout editor's toolbar on a faked AYN Odin (6 in, 1080p) never traps a control: START dragged onto the layout button (Done), L (at the top) chosen: its panel is placed clear of the toolbar; L dragged up into the top middle (where the long help text was), grabbed again there and moved back; the toolbar goes where it covers no control (logged: "over controls: 0") and its longest text is short (no title, no paragraph: under 40 characters); then a one-finger tap on Done, START under it, closes the editor. Before: the bar owned its whole area, so a control left under its text could never be grabbed again ($TTYD_TOUCH_EDIT_DO drag=<control>,done,<frames>; "ui_shots": touch_<frame>_ui.png)
log_must: \[touch\] toolbar: at [-0-9]+,[-0-9]+-[-0-9]+,[-0-9]+; over controls: 0; longest text: ([0-9]|[1-3][0-9]) chars
